course.title: Technology 7–8
course.classification: Mandatory course — Food and agricultural practices

outcomes.statement: explains relationships between sustainability, design and production
describes the practices and processes of designers and producers
explains how materials, systems and components contribute to solutions
applies processes in the planning, management and production of projects
communicates and evaluates design ideas and solutions
selects and safely uses tools, materials, technologies and processes
demonstrates technological literacy to safely interact in digital environments
uses data and digital systems to code, design and produce projects

periods.student_work: Use M1-S1 to establish room expectations, safe participation and the practical-learning cycle. Complete the 10-question check and written response.
syllabus_content: Safe practices; designer and producer practices.
periods.evidence: M1-S1 check + response | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PDP-01

periods.student_work: Teach M1-S2. Model a safe personal-hygiene routine, explain contamination pathways and complete the knowledge check and written response.
syllabus_content: Safe food-handling processes; justify safe choices.
periods.evidence: M1-S2 check + response | TE4-SAF-01

periods.student_work: Teach M1-S3, washing-up workflow and hazard controls. Complete required OnGuard activities nominated by the school before practical access.
syllabus_content: Select and safely use tools, technologies and processes.
periods.evidence: M1-S3 check + response; OnGuard record | TE4-SAF-01

periods.student_work: Teach M2-S1 using the Lemonade Scones and Savoury Twists masters. Identify ingredients, quantities, method verbs, equipment and sequence.
syllabus_content: Interpret food-production information; justify equipment and processes.
periods.evidence: M2-S1 check + response | TE4-PDP-01, TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Apply hygiene, accurate measuring and the authorised recipe method. Allocate roles and organise the workstation before production.
syllabus_content: Use equipment, tools, techniques and processes to develop practical skills.
periods.evidence: Teacher observation; M2-S2 measuring evidence | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Complete production, clean down safely and compare the result with recipe intent. Complete the M2-S2 check and written response after the practical.
syllabus_content: Produce and evaluate a food solution; demonstrate safe practices.
periods.evidence: Finished product + evaluation; M2-S2 check/response | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Teach M2-S3. Connect nutrient functions and food sources, then complete the knowledge check, written response and Activity 3.
syllabus_content: Investigate nutritional needs and characteristics of food products.
periods.evidence: M2-S3 check/response; Activity 3 | TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Unpack the three approved assessment tasks, issue dates, end-of-semester timing and evidence expectations. Establish Task 2 website/PowerPoint and the eight-stage folio.
syllabus_content: Document and communicate design and production processes; safe digital interaction.
periods.evidence: Assessment acknowledgement; folio setup | TE4-DES-01, TE4-DIG-01

periods.student_work: Teach M3-S1 and use Activity 4 to build a role-aware workflow plan for Savoury Twists. Complete the check and written response.
syllabus_content: Plan and manage food-production processes; work collaboratively.
periods.evidence: M3-S1 check/response; Activity 4 plan | TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Follow the authorised recipe and team plan. Apply safe workflow, monitor time, clean down and record one process improvement.
syllabus_content: Select preparation techniques and production skills; test and improve products.
periods.evidence: Product + workflow review | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PPM-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Teach M3-S2 using the five Australian Guide to Healthy Eating groups and adolescent needs. Complete the check, response and Activity 8.
syllabus_content: Investigate nutritional needs of individuals and groups with specific needs.
periods.evidence: M3-S2 check/response; Activity 8 | TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Produce the authorised recipe safely. Relate ingredient choices to food groups and adolescent needs; record a concise nutrition reflection.
syllabus_content: Prepare food solutions; evaluate ingredient selection and nutritional value.
periods.evidence: Product + nutrition reflection | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Teach M3-S3. Compare Bread Cases and Garlic Cheese Flatbread, then justify a modification using nutrition, production feasibility and sustainability evidence.
syllabus_content: Assess food-solution ideas; explain relationships between sustainability, design and production.
periods.evidence: M3-S3 check/response; modification rationale | TE4-DES-01, TE4-MSC-01, TE4-SDP-01

periods.student_work: Produce the authorised recipe using an organised workflow. Compare the outcome with design intent and justify one improvement.
syllabus_content: Use food-preparation techniques; evaluate quality of food solutions.
periods.evidence: Product + improvement note | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Teach M4-S1. Develop audience, need and success criteria for a balanced adolescent lunchbox. Complete the check and written response.
syllabus_content: Apply critical and creative thinking to assess food-solution ideas.
periods.evidence: M4-S1 check/response; criteria | TE4-DES-01, TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Teach M4-S2. Prepare a complete food order, time plan and practical organisation record for the Healthy Lunchbox task. Complete the check and response.
syllabus_content: Plan and manage production; justify equipment, processes and resources.
periods.evidence: M4-S2 check/response; order + time plan | TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Produce Coconut Balls from the authorised master. Apply safe hygiene and portioning, then record observations relevant to healthier fast-food redesign.
syllabus_content: Develop practical skills; evaluate ingredient selection and preparation techniques.
periods.evidence: Product + observation record | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Teach M4-S3. Redesign a fast-food idea using nutrition, producer-practice and sustainability evidence, then complete the check and written response.
syllabus_content: Evaluate food solutions; explain relationships between sustainability, design and production.
periods.evidence: M4-S3 check/response; redesign rationale | TE4-DES-01, TE4-PDP-01, TE4-SDP-01

periods.student_work: Develop Task 2 for an adolescent audience. Show how sustainability, producer practice and project planning shaped the solution; use clear navigation and safe digital choices.
syllabus_content: Relate sustainability, design and production; plan and communicate solutions using digital systems.
periods.evidence: Task 2 checkpoint + screenshot evidence | TE4-SDP-01, TE4-PDP-01, TE4-PPM-01, TE4-DES-01, TE4-DIG-01, TE4-DIG-02

periods.student_work: Complete Task 1 design brief, criteria, food order, workflow and risk controls. Teacher checks feasibility before ingredients are ordered.
syllabus_content: Document design processes; plan and manage production projects.
periods.evidence: Approved Task 1 plan + folio stages | TE4-PPM-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Use course checks and teacher feedback to address misconceptions. Confirm Task 1 practical readiness and rehearse individual design-knowledge responses.
syllabus_content: Communicate design knowledge; justify selections and improvements.
periods.evidence: Feedback record; approved readiness check | TE4-DES-01, TE4-SAF-01

periods.student_work: Complete the first assessed production block using the approved plan. Apply hygiene, time management and safe equipment use; teacher records practical evidence.
syllabus_content: Apply planning, management and safe production processes.
periods.evidence: Task 1 practical observation | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Complete production, presentation and safe clean-down. Photograph only the food solution within school privacy rules and collect evaluation evidence.
syllabus_content: Produce and evaluate a food solution; document production processes.
periods.evidence: Task 1 product + practical evidence | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Teach M5-S3. Evaluate the food solution and communication tool using sustainability, production, project-planning, appeal and ease-of-use evidence; identify one improvement.
syllabus_content: Communicate and evaluate design solutions, production relationships and digital user experience.
periods.evidence: M5-S3 response; Task 2 evaluation | TE4-SDP-01, TE4-PDP-01, TE4-PPM-01, TE4-DES-01, TE4-DIG-01, TE4-DIG-02

periods.student_work: Teach M5-S1. Connect fibre and water to healthy body function and adolescent food choices. Complete the check, written response and relevant recipe analysis.
syllabus_content: Investigate nutritional needs and evaluate ingredient selection.
periods.evidence: M5-S1 check + response | TE4-MSC-01

periods.student_work: Use the teacher-confirmed muffin master to plan, measure and begin production. Do not order ingredients until the Basic Muffins/Choc Chip Muffins source conflict is resolved.
syllabus_content: Select preparation techniques and safely produce food solutions.
periods.evidence: Practical observation + method record | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Complete production and clean-down using the confirmed master. Evaluate method, texture and one evidence-based improvement; add the record to the folio.
syllabus_content: Test, modify and improve food products; evaluate quality using design factors.
periods.evidence: Product + evaluation | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-DES-01

periods.student_work: Administer the approved 45-minute individual in-class Design Knowledge Task under the formal notification conditions. Retain teacher marking and feedback records.
syllabus_content: Apply sustainability, producer-practice, food-materials and digital knowledge.
periods.evidence: Task 3 response /15 | TE4-SDP-01, TE4-PDP-01, TE4-MSC-01, TE4-DIG-01, TE4-DIG-02

periods.student_work: Teach M5-S2 within the practical briefing. Plan a safe sequence, prepare the authorised recipe and complete the embedded knowledge check.
syllabus_content: Plan, manage and safely apply food-production processes.
periods.evidence: M5-S2 check; workflow observation | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-PPM-01

periods.student_work: Complete Carbonara, safe clean-down and the M5-S2 written response. Finalise folio evidence and record Task 2 submission status for the applicable semester deadline.
syllabus_content: Produce, document, communicate and evaluate design solutions.
periods.evidence: Product + M5-S2 response; folio status | TE4-SAF-01, TE4-DES-01

teacher_to_confirm.item: Confirm how the 30 periods are placed in the school timetable and which practicals run as consecutive double periods.
Confirm class-specific allergies, dietary needs, approved ingredients, equipment, supervision and current risk controls.
Resolve the muffin source conflict: the weekly program names Choc Chip Muffins while the supplied recipe master is Basic Muffins.
Insert the exact Semester 1 or Semester 2 due dates and confirm Google Classroom collection settings before notifications are issued.
